en.title: You Who Cannot Lie, and the Love That Melts on the Night of the Lunar Eclipse
en.premise: "As long as there's delicious food, life is perfect!" That's my philosophy as a high school girl with a massive appetite. But my life takes a turn when a handsome new transfer student arrives—one who is cursed with the "inability to lie," making him uncontrollably sharp-tongued. Our days are a chaotic whirlwind of mismatched rhythms that somehow, strangely, fit together perfectly. And on the night of the lunar eclipse, the "truths" we've both been hiding will begin to melt away, just like a sweet dessert.

zh.title: 无法撒谎的你，与在月食之夜融化的恋心
zh.premise: “只要有美食，人生就是最棒的！”——我是一个只要有美食就能感到幸福的贪吃女高中生。就在这时，一名转学生出现在我面前。他长得帅气，却因为“无法撒谎的诅咒”，变得毒舌不已。与那个只能说出真心话的他，度过了看似不合拍却又契合的喧闹日常。而在月食之夜，两人一直隐藏着的“真相”，将如甜点般缓缓融化——。
